references.text: The Levites shall camp around the tabernacle of the testimony and keep guard at it, so that wrath may not come upon the congregation of Israel.
The Levites shall serve their brothers at the tent of meeting and keep watch, but they shall not perform any work. This elaborates on the Levites' duty of service.
The Levites shall take charge of your guard and the guard over the entire tent, and they shall be joined to you and keep watch at the tent of meeting.
Describes the specific duties of Gershon's sons at the tabernacle, which are part of the Levites' service.
Describes the responsibility of Kohath's sons for the holy objects in the tabernacle.
Describes the responsibility of Merari's sons for the framework and structure of the tabernacle.
Aaron and his sons shall tend the lamps in the tent of meeting, outside the veil that is before the testimony. An early reference to service at the tent of meeting.
Overview of the materials of the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the testimony, for which the Levites were given responsibility under the leadership of Ithamar.
Aaron and his sons shall remain at the entrance to the tent of meeting day and night for seven days and keep the Lord's watch. A parallel to keeping watch at the sanctuary.
The service of the gatekeepers at the house of the Lord, the tabernacle, shows the continuity of the Levites' watch.
